definitions.gloss: to ride past; to miss one's stop
definitions.explanation: to stay on a train, bus, etc. past the intended destination

examples.japanese: ⟦{居眠|いねむ}り→居眠り：01822_inemuri⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{終点|しゅうてん}→終点：05457_shuuten⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{乗|の}り{過|す}ごしてしまった。
examples.english: I dozed off and rode all the way to the terminal.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{夢中|むちゅう}→夢中：03752_muchuu⟧で{乗|の}り{過|す}ごさないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: Don't miss your stop because you're absorbed in your phone.

notes:
{乗|の}り{過|す}ごす is commonly used for missing stops on public transportation.

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (す-verb)
- Transitive (takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧)

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ (to ride) + ⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ (to spend/pass)
- Part of the productive ～⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ compound pattern

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乗|の}り{過|す}ごす (miss a station)
- ⟦バス{停|てい}→バス停：05295_basutei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乗|の}り{過|す}ごす (miss a bus stop)
- ⟦{終点|しゅうてん}→終点：05457_shuuten⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{乗|の}り{過|す}ごす (ride to the terminal)
- ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧{乗|の}り{過|す}ごす (accidentally ride past)

COMMON CAUSES:
- ⟦{居眠|いねむ}り→居眠り：01822_inemuri⟧ (dozing)
- ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧ (smartphone)
- {本|ほん} (reading a book)
- {考|かんが}え{事|ごと} (lost in thought)

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎる→通り過ぎる：02372_toorisugiru⟧ (to pass by)
- {見過|みすご}ごす (to overlook)
- {聞|き}き{過|す}ごす (to fail to hear)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{乗|の}り→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ (to ride too much/long - different meaning)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Very common experience in Japan given extensive train/subway use
- Station announcements help prevent this
- Apps like ⟦{乗換案内|のりかえあんない}→乗換案内：27578_norikaeannai⟧ have alarm features

REGISTER: Neutral. Very common in everyday conversation.
